rooms.name: Gates of Ravenloft
rooms.desc: The road swings east and Castle Ravenloft fills the sky. Two broken stone turrets guard the near edge of a fog-filled chasm fifty feet across; an old drawbridge spans it to the gate, and gargoyles leer down from the walls. Through the arch the castle doors stand open on a warmly lit courtyard.
rooms.dm: Assumes arrival by the black carriage from I; adjust otherwise. Beyond the gate passage: the front courtyard, K1 (open ch04/K).

rooms.name: Drawbridge
rooms.desc: Old beams, patched and propped, with gaps where boards have fallen through. It groans under every step.
rooms.dm: Each crossing by anyone but Strahd or his carriage horses: 5% chance a board breaks. DC 10 Dexterity save or fall 1,000 ft to the bottom of the cliffs; advantage if a companion within 5 ft reaches out to grab.

rooms.name: Entry tunnel
rooms.desc: A tunnel through the curtain wall under the rotting portcullis, warm light at its far end.
rooms.dm: Green slime on the portcullis (see the hidden object).

objects.label: The chasm
objects.desc: Fog fills the chasm from wall to wall; there is no seeing the bottom.

objects.label: Drawbridge
objects.desc: The drawbridge lies down across the chasm on rusty chains that creak in the wind.

objects.label: Curtain wall
objects.desc: The castle's curtain wall rises ninety feet, sheer and grey.

objects.label: Rotting portcullis
objects.desc: A wooden portcullis, rotten and furred green, is drawn up into the arch overhead.
objects.dm: A patch of green slime clings to it (DC 20 Wisdom (Perception) to spot). It does not fall on characters entering the castle; it falls on the first character who leaves this way.

objects.dm: Green slime (DMG ch.5). Spotted with DC 20 Wisdom (Perception). Falls on the first character to leave by this tunnel.
